audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues and no cooldown appears anywhere. The tracked cooldown the whole page is built around is Blooming Blows.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 seconds — it is effectively always up, so 'engage when Blooming Blows is down' is advice that can never be executed. The cooldown that actually gates this matchup is Lilting Lullaby at 150/130/110, and Swirlseed at a flat 12s is her poke timer.
audit.corrected: 110-150s Lilting Lullaby written into mid; Swirlseed's 12s / 700-range poke added to early and whys[2].
sources: packet defects: NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere

audit.whatIsWrong: Nine fields describe Lillia dashing or bouncing away — 'Blooming Blast bounce', 'no Blooming Blast to dash out', 'her Watch Out! dash', 'she'll just bounce away'. Lillia has no dash in her kit. Separately the ult was described as a plain sleep with no precondition, Blooming Blows' true damage was never mentioned, and Swirlseed does not appear anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's Blooming Blows is a point-blank AoE with stacking move speed on spell hit and extra TRUE damage on the outer edge — no leap, no bounce. Watch Out! Eep! is a point-blank area hit with a heavy centre, also no dash. Her only mobility is the passive move-speed stacking, which means she has to walk into Gnar's range to deal damage and cannot leave a Wallop. Lilting Lullaby only drowsies enemies already carrying Dream-Laden Bough burn, so if you have not been hit by one of her spells, a 110-second ult does nothing to you — that is the single most useful fact in the matchup and it was missing. Blooming Blows' edge is true damage, so armour is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Every dash/bounce claim replaced with the real mechanic (she must step to point-blank range) in whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid, wants.you[0], wants.you[1]. The Dream Dust precondition on R written into spikes[2].text, mid, wants.foe[1]. Q's true damage added to early; Swirlseed added to early, whys[2] and wants.foe[0].
sources: enemyKit Blooming Blows / Watch Out! Eep! / Swirlseed / Lilting Lullaby / Dream-Laden Bough text

notes: The single biggest fix here: the page had Lillia dashing and bouncing in nine separate places. She has no dash — Blooming Blows is a point-blank AoE with stacking move speed and true damage on the outer edge, and Watch Out! Eep! is also point-blank. She has to walk into Gnar's range to do anything, which reverses how the reader should play the kite. Second: Lilting Lullaby only affects targets already carrying Dream-Laden Bough burn, so avoiding her poke disables her 110-second ult entirely — that was missing and it is the matchup's key point. Whole-page issue I could not fix from writable prose alone: the full layer tracks 'Blooming Blows' as the matchup-defining cooldown (focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5]/[9]/[10]/[13]). It is a 4-6 second cooldown and can never be 'down' — the tracked cooldown should be Lilting Lullaby. focus.text is 21 characters, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so it needs a manual change.
